tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page canvas behind cards, and the bottom action strip. The ground of every screen.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, the header, the tab bar, the voice bar and sheets. Was bgElevated.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Quiet fills inside a surface: chips, source tags, text fields, gray buttons, the pressed state of a row. Was bgSubtle.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline edge of cards, chips, pills and bars (stroke-hair). Decorative, so exempt from 3:1; never the only thing that marks a control. Was border.

tokens.name: line-subtle
tokens.usage: Separators inside a card or list group. Was borderSubtle.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons, on bg, surface and fill. Was text.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, captions, eyebrows, inactive tabs, placeholders, on bg, surface and fill. Light was #6b7280 (4.2:1 on fill); deepened to pass. Was textMuted.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Identity only: the active tab indicator, the tuned spot's edge, the watched star, the Log column letter. Never a button fill, never a state. As text on surface and brand-subtle. Light was #e63946 (4.2:1 on white, 3.4:1 on brand-subtle); deepened to pass. Was accent.

tokens.name: brand-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of the tuned spot row. Was accentSubtle.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text on a brand fill (tab badges).

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Selection and engagement: a filter that is on, the selected segment, links, filled primary buttons, the focus ring. As text on surface, fill and tint-subtle. Was info.

tokens.name: tint-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of a selected chip, an engaged banner or an info notice. Was infoSubtle.

tokens.name: on-tint
tokens.usage: Text on a tint fill.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Good or go: Live, connected, worked, park refs, Start, Log QSO. As text on surface and ok-subtle, and as a fill under on-ok. Light was #0e9f6e (3.4:1 as text and under white); deepened to pass.

tokens.name: ok-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of a good-state pill or row (Live, worked today). Was okSubtle.

tokens.name: on-ok
tokens.usage: Text on an ok fill. Dark ink in dark themes: white on the dark ok is 2.1:1.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Caution, not stopped: stale data, Tune, a skipped spot, SWR rising. As text on surface and warn-subtle, and as a fill under on-warn.

tokens.name: warn-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of a caution notice or row. New: today hard-coded as rgba(240,179,65,0.16).

tokens.name: on-warn
tokens.usage: Text on a warn fill. Dark ink in dark themes: white on the dark warn is 1.9:1.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Stop, alert, destructive: HALT, Stop TX, Delete, End activation, errors, a lost link. As text on surface and danger-subtle, and as a fill under on-danger. Was bad.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of a destructive button and an error notice. New: today HALT and CW STOP hard-code #3b1010 in every theme.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (Stop TX).

tokens.name: air
tokens.usage: On the air: the PTT button, the ON AIR banner, the TX marker on a waterfall. PTT is the only red filled at rest. Skins keep it red (Skins: invariants). Dark was #ff6b76 under white (2.8:1); deepened so the white label passes.

tokens.name: air-subtle
tokens.usage: Ground of a transmitting row: the TX decode row, the macro that is sending.

tokens.name: on-air
tokens.usage: The label on an air fill. Always white.

tokens.name: air-deep
tokens.usage: The slot progress bar that grows along the bottom of the ON AIR banner, on air. About 2.5:1 against air: a progress fill, not text, so it is drawn 8 pt tall to read.

tokens.name: air-ink
tokens.usage: On-air text on surface and air-subtle: "ON AIR", "TX", a sending macro.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Secondary filled controls in the action strip: Scan, Audio, Speaker. Dark navy in every default theme. Was navy.

tokens.name: control-line
tokens.usage: Edge of a control. Was navySubtle.

tokens.name: on-control
tokens.usage: Text on a control fill.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: The magenta band hint on spot rows, as on the desktop. As text on surface. Light was #d946ef (3.5:1); deepened to pass.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind every sheet and dialog. Today 0.35 to 0.6 in 30 places; one value.

tokens.name: shadow-ink
tokens.usage: Colour of shadow-card (light themes only).

tokens.name: meter-s
tokens.usage: The S meter fill. Today brand red, which reads as "on air" at rest; proposed tint.

tokens.name: meter-swr
tokens.usage: The SWR meter fill below the warning point; warn above it, danger at the trip point.

tokens.name: meter-track
tokens.usage: The empty part of a meter, edged with line.

tokens.name: source-pota
tokens.usage: POTA map pins, legend dots and the ATNO tag ground (under #000 ink). Spot rows show sources as neutral tags.

tokens.name: source-sota
tokens.usage: SOTA pins and legend.

tokens.name: source-wwff
tokens.usage: WWFF pins and legend.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, Roboto, sans-serif

styles.name: title-screen
styles.usage: One per screen, for a screen with no header of its own (Act, the wizard, empty states).

styles.name: title-sheet
styles.usage: Sheet and dialog titles; Settings stack titles.

styles.name: title-card
styles.usage: A card or list-group title. Replaces 15/800, 15/700, 14/700 and 14/800.

styles.name: row-title
styles.usage: The identity of a row: a callsign, a gateway, a contest. One per row.

styles.name: row-body
styles.usage: The line under row-title: operator name, park name.

styles.name: row-value
styles.usage: The value column at a row's right edge: frequency, distance, count. Always tabular.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The shack keeps the password and signs in for you.
styles.usage: Paragraphs, list-row labels, text fields.

styles.name: help
styles.sample: Shown after the callsign on Spots rows.
styles.usage: Help under a field or a setting. Replaces 12/16, 13/18 and 11/15.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Pill and small-button text, park refs, values in a meta line.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Chip text, the header mode pill and ping.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section headers and field labels, uppercase, ink-muted. The one section-header style (today there are 13).

styles.name: eyebrow-strip
styles.usage: Labels inside the bottom strips: VOICE, S, SWR.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Source tags and event tags (NEW SLOT, ATNO, WORKED), uppercase.

styles.name: button-lg
styles.usage: Text of a 50 pt button, and the PTT label.

styles.name: button-md
styles.usage: Text of a 44 pt button.

styles.name: button-sm
styles.usage: Text of a 30 pt button (Skip, Hide, Refresh).

styles.name: numeric-header
styles.usage: The header frequency. Tabular.

styles.name: numeric-mark
styles.usage: A large single mark: the Log column letter, a big count.

styles.name: numeric-dial
styles.usage: The VFO dial and the dialpad readout. Tabular.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Decodes, JTTY and JS8 text, logs. Menlo on iOS, monospace on Android: fontFamily "monospace" does not exist on iOS.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Decode metadata columns: dB, DT, offset.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between stacked tags in a source column.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Half the row gap; tight icon-to-text.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between chips in a meta line; chip horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: The default gap between siblings in a row, and between rows (4 above, 4 below).

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Card vertical padding; the gap inside a row's body.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Screen side inset, card horizontal padding, header padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Sheet padding; the tab bar inset.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between sections; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Bottom padding of a scrolling screen, above its strips.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Screen side inset for cards, bars and banners, on every screen.

tokens.name: card-pad-x
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding inside a card or list row.

tokens.name: card-pad-y
tokens.usage: Vertical padding inside a card or list row.

tokens.name: section-gap
tokens.usage: Space above a section header.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Source and event tags, small badges. Spots uses 3 and 4 today; one value.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, 30 pt buttons, the header mode pill. The Spots chip (5) snaps to 6.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Pills, text fields, 44 and 50 pt buttons, macro buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, spot rows, list groups, banners.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Centred dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: The top corners of a bottom sheet.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Capsules: count badges, round strip controls, toggles.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards in light themes only. Dark themes separate surfaces by value and line, never by shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: The top edge of a bottom sheet in light themes.

tokens.name: size-hit
tokens.usage: The smallest tap target, by padding or hitSlop.

tokens.name: size-button-lg
tokens.usage: The one main action of a screen or sheet.

tokens.name: size-button-md
tokens.usage: Ordinary buttons.

tokens.name: size-button-sm
tokens.usage: Inline row actions (Skip, Hide, Refresh).

tokens.name: size-ptt
tokens.usage: The PTT button. Nothing else is this size.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Round strip controls: Scan, HALT.

tokens.name: size-log-col
tokens.usage: The Log column at a spot row's right edge.

size.note: Fixed by the system: a skin never changes these.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth: card, chip and bar edges.

tokens.name: stroke-1
tokens.usage: Text fields, outlined buttons, banners.

tokens.name: stroke-strong
tokens.usage: A control that is armed or selected: an active macro, HALT.

tokens.name: stroke-indicator
tokens.usage: The active tab underline; a selected card edge.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: A disabled control, whole.

tokens.name: opacity-pressed
tokens.usage: Text-only buttons while pressed.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Small glyphs inside chips, tags and dense rows.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: The default icon size: buttons, list rows, toolbars.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Large icons: empty states, the tab bar, sheet headers.

icon.note: Fixed by the system: a skin never changes these.
